stock.description: Operating within the People's Republic of China, Aoyuan Healthy Life Group Company Limited, through its various subsidiaries, specializes in delivering comprehensive property management and commercial operations solutions. Its property management portfolio encompasses a diverse range of facilities, including premium residential complexes, commercial centers, apartments, office buildings, villas, and even tourist destinations. Additionally, the firm assists property developers with services such as cleaning, landscaping, security, and maintenance, and provides various supplementary offerings to tenants and property owners. By the close of 2020, its property management footprint had expanded to cover approximately 41.4 million square meters across 346 properties situated in 63 cities, spanning 19 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions throughout China. Beyond property management, Aoyuan Healthy Life Group offers comprehensive commercial operational services specifically tailored for shopping malls. These services include strategic pre-planning, commercial space design, expert technical consultation, tenant procurement, grand opening preparations, and ongoing asset management. The company's diverse service offerings further extend into healthcare, providing traditional Chinese medicine, senior care, health management advisory, and Western medical diagnostic and treatment solutions. Moreover, it delivers specialized services in decoration and furnishing, design management and consultancy, installation and heating systems, and engineering advisory. Established in 2000, the company's headquarters are located in Guangzhou, China. Aoyuan Healthy Life Group Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Main Trend Limited.
